anomalies.observed: For each TMC2209, the CPO and CPI pins are each connected to a separate capacitor to GND: C47 (22 nF) and C43 (100 nF) for U8, with the same arrangement at U3 and U9. There is no capacitor connected between CPO and CPI.
anomalies.expected: The TMC2209 charge-pump capacitor should be connected between CPO and CPI, not replaced by separate capacitors from each pin to GND.

anomalies.impact: The charge-pump circuit is not wired as required, which can prevent the TMC2209 drivers from generating the gate-drive voltage needed for normal motor operation; the three dosing pumps may fail to run or operate unreliably.

parsed.summary: An anomaly is present: all three TMC2209 drivers have their CPO and CPI charge-pump pins bypassed to ground through separate capacitors instead of being coupled by the required charge-pump capacitor. This can compromise operation of the dosing-pump drivers.
